article.title: Quiz: guess the idiom's meaning
article.description: Quiz format: 'What does "spill the beans" mean? a) Cook dinner  b) Reveal a secret  c) Make a mistake  d) Waste money' Answer: b) Reveal a secret. Teaching point: this idiom is commonly used informally when someone accidentally or deliberately shares confidential information.

slides.body: The idiom "spill the beans" is used informally to describe revealing a secret or confidential information. This often happens accidentally, perhaps by saying something without thinking, but it can also be done deliberately. For instance, if you accidentally mention a friend's surprise birthday party, you've "spilled the beans" and ruined the surprise. It's a colorful way to talk about letting sensitive information out.
